summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep_private. Woot documentation proves API access but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights, while public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown; ordinary reversible growth may continue where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries are preserved. Do not send rights outreach or change the private gate. Exact decision: retain keep_private until authoritative rights evidence, human counsel review, non-legal gates, and owner disposition are complete.

Legal launch gate: do not expose SearchWoot publicly or expand alerts. Continue only read-only evidence capture. The existing repository evidence is partial: backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, config.yml, privacy.html, cookie-policy.html, and draft terms.html are identified, but operator-confirmed retention, deletion, correction, access, notification behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures remain missing. Next evidence action: attach one dated bundle containing the data-flow/retention table, deployed consent behavior, GA4 settings, log-field/vendor inventory, and incident/request workflow; do not enable tracking or mutate production.

Legal confirms the SearchWoot private gate remains in force. Do not clear security or release gates from the current snapshot: fleet-doctor has no run/findings, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and the security matrix remains unevidenced. Continue the existing authorized read-only matrix and record dated evidence, unknowns, owners, severity, and release implications. No credentials, configuration changes, deployment, dependency additions, or external outreach.

Revenue and measurement remain non-blocking for ordinary reversible growth but block SearchWoot launch clearance. Amazon evidence is 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with all commission in aggregate tracking ID other and not assignable to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift. Keep the measurement gate blocked until traffic, affiliate attribution, direct costs, and site/content identifiers reconcile.
